desc: Read input and parse $N$ and array $A$.
Compute prefix distinct counts array `Pre` and suffix distinct counts array `Suf`.
Initialize a Segment Tree with `Pre` values to support range add and range max queries.
Iterate $j$ from 2 to $N-1$, updating the Segment Tree based on the last occurrence of $A[j]$ and querying the maximum value to compute the answer.
